last_message: I added ADR `docs/adr/0002-send-pickup-reminders-by-sms.md`, following the same format as 0001, documenting why SMS stays: email was tried April–June 2025, 34% of reminders went unopened, and missed pickups roughly doubled (6%→13%) until the July 1, 2025 switch back to SMS. I linked it from `docs/adr/README.md` so it's discoverable the next time someone proposes email reminders.
